feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 July 2026 4:16pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 24 July 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure is displaced from the northwest by an approaching frontal system tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 in the east and south of the area this evening and variable 2 to 4 in the north. Becoming west or southwest 4 or 5 in all waters overnight, then backing southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning before veering west or northwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain or drizzle arriving tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 to 5, falling variable 2 to 4 at times, then settling west 5 or 6 on Sunday morning, veering west or northwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated rain or drizzle becoming occasional overnight before tending to clear to showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation.
